meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体辩论团队，穷尽式深挖问题并产出带引用的综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果遇到难以定论的复杂课题时，希望自动启动一支多角色研究团队穷尽论证
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent deep research and deliver a cited synthesis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough, multi-angle investigation on a hard question without managing many sub-agents yourself.

howto.what: 当用户明确要求研究时,技能会接管:先自行分解问题并询问输出格式,然后组建最多8人的研究团队,分派各轴、辩论与探索任务,持续记录日志,用代码或声明图验证有争议的结论,最终生成带引用和图表、并经过视觉与校对检查的综合报告。
howto.when: 仅在用户明确要求研究时触发,例如说出“ulw-research”等关键词,或请求深度研究(deep research)、超精确调查(ultra-precise investigation)等;普通问题与调试不会激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下 LLM 在代码生成中的安全风险
say.note: 将进入该技能,组建团队并产出带引用的研究报告。

say.text: 请做 deep research,对比三家云厂商的 Serverless 定价
say.note: 会触发深度研究流程,自动询问输出格式并搭建团队。

say.text: 启动 ultradebate,论证 RAG 是否会长期主导知识问答
say.note: 会激活辩论式研究,由红队成员交叉质询结论。

howto.what_en: On explicit research demand, it scopes, asks output format, builds a max-size team with per-axis and skeptic members, runs debates and EXPAND loops, verifies claims via code or claim-graph, then outputs a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets through visual-QA and writing proofread gates.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit research demand, such as saying 'ulw-research', 'deep research', or 'ultra-precise investigation', in any language; ordinary questions or debugging do not activate it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate security risks of LLM in code generation.
say_en.note: Builds a team and outputs a cited report.

say_en.text: Do a deep research comparing serverless pricing of three cloud vendors.
say_en.note: Asks output format and assembles a team.

say_en.text: Start an ultradebate on whether RAG will dominate knowledge QA in the long run.
say_en.note: Activates debate-style research with red-team cross-examination.
